mv Point m/sub
-- a.go --
package m

type Point struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

var Origin = Point{0, 0}
-- b.go --
package m

var P = Point{X: 1, Y: 2}
-- sub/sub.go --
package sub

import "m"

var _ = m.Point{1, 2}
